name: RYUGYONG PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

attribution.legal_posture: Entity designated under the Republic of Korea's unilateral sanctions regime for involvement in dispatching or supporting DPRK IT personnel; MSMT states that the five listed names and variations refer to this same 75 Guidance Bureau/Munitions Industry Department company; this is an administrative sanctions designation, with no criminal charge or conviction on record.

caveats: Similarly named Ryugyong entities require a source link before they are treated as one organization.
Name similarity alone is insufficient to merge any other Ryugyong-named organization.
Preserve the ROK-designated primary name and source each alias to MSMT.

Stored in the schema's front_company category for publication compatibility; the official source describes a designated DPRK IT-worker entity, while sham-company legal status requires a separate source.

The dated designation announcement and the living sanctions list are two Republic of Korea Ministry of Foreign Affairs publications in one official source family; retain both for complementary claim-level support and treat them as one source family. The living-list citation establishes list presence and naming as accessed; current activity, location, role, and operational control require newer evidence.
Source-reported alias variations refer to one Ryugyong company; company count remains one.
